subject: Music Production
title: Lee Scratch Perry and Dub
description: A quick win: understand Lee Scratch Perry and Dub.

hook.text: In 1970s Jamaica, Lee 'Scratch' Perry built a studio in his backyard using scavenged equipment.

buildup.text: He stripped reggae songs down to drums and bass, then drowned them in echo and reverb effects.

discovery.text: Perry invented dub music by treating the mixing board itself as a live performance instrument.

twist.text: His methods were so unorthodox that he once buried tapes in his yard for spiritual inspiration.

climax.text: Dub's echo-heavy production influenced punk, hip-hop, electronic music, and modern pop.

punchline.text: A backyard studio in Jamaica invented a whole genre.

quiz.question: How did Lee Scratch Perry create dub music?
options: By treating the mixing board as a live instrument with echo
By adding orchestral strings to reggae
